name.description: A user-defined name for the report.

creatorEmail.description: The email address of the report creator. This email address will receive an email notification when the report has completed.

start.description: `yyyy-mm-dd` start date of the report time period.

end.description: `yyyy-mm-dd` end date of the report time period.

comparisonContractId.description: ID of the EmploymentContract to use for comparison. Set this to empty string if using awardOverride.

awardOverride.description: Name of the award to use for comparison, e.g. `au/casual-2022-01-01-teachersa-earlychildhood-1`

awardBaseRateOverride.description: The base hourly rate to use for comparison with an award.

outerLimitOvertime.description: Outer limit value for overtime pay, in hours. Optional, default 0.

outerLimitPenalty.description: Outer limit value for penalty pay, in hours. Optional, default 0.

includeOuterLimitOvertime.description: Whether outer limit should be used for overtime. Optional, default false.

includeOuterLimitPenalty.description: Whether outer limit should be used for penalty. Optional, default false.

limit.description: Limit the result set returned after applying filters.

offset.description: Offset (from the first result) the result set returned after applying filters.

contractIds.description: Filter the employees based on main contract.

limit.description: Limit the result set returned after applying filters.

offset.description: Offset (from the first result) the result set returned after applying filters.

contractIds.description: Used to match employees by their contract linked by the agreement on their main location.

includeEmployeeIds.description: Employees with IDs matching this field will be added to the set of results, if they are not matched already.

includeCompanyIds.description: Employees that are associated with the Company matching any of the IDs will be added to the set of results.

includeTrainingModuleIds.description: Employees that have any of the matching TrainingModule IDs.

includeJobPositions.description: Employees based on the given Job Positions. (Will be set to empty if install is not Enterprise).

includeEmployeesWithNameLike.description: Employees will be added to the results if they have Name matching this value. `%` can be used as a wildcard.

cycleStart.description: `yyyy-mm-dd` date to specify the start of the cycle.

daysInCycle.description: Number of days in each cycle, e.g. Weekly = 7, Fortnightly = 14, 4-Weekly = 28.
